system.name: CREST
system.one_liner: a disaggregated transaction system that handles high-contention workloads via cell-level concurrency control, localized execution, and parallel commits

components.name: Coordinators
components.role: compute-node component holding a transaction's pending update and driving its execution

components.name: Txn Logic
components.role: logic that manages a transaction's execution

components.name: Txn1
components.role: a transaction pipelined through localized execution

components.name: Txn2
components.role: a transaction pipelined through localized execution

components.name: Txn3
components.role: a transaction pipelined through localized execution

components.name: RDMA
components.role: RDMA operation issued by a pipelined transaction

components.name: Pipeline Execution
components.role: pipelines multiple transactions' RDMA operations under two-phase locking

components.name: 2PL
components.role: two-phase locking used to order the pipelined RDMA operations

components.name: Cache Management
components.role: manages the coordinator's Record Cache entries (cache mode, admission) for localized execution

components.name: Record Cache
components.role: per-coordinator cache entry (Key, Ref, EN Array, Version List) for locally executing on a record

components.name: Remote Records
components.role: memory-node-side records laid out as a header followed by a row of cells

flows.what: dispatch of a transaction into the execution pipeline
admission of a locally cached record version
cache-mode read or update of the remote record

content.key_idea: A coordinator pipelines RDMA-based access to its own compute node's uncommitted record versions under 2PL, avoiding a round trip to fetch the latest version from the memory pool.
content.reading_order: Top-down: the Coordinators/Pipeline Execution/Cache Management block on the CNs row, then down across the CNs/MNs divider to Remote Records.

Figure 8 shows the workflow of localized execution.

summary: Figure 8 walks through localized execution, the technique that lets a CREST coordinator operate on uncommitted record versions from transactions on its own compute node instead of fetching the latest version from the memory pool. On the CNs (compute-node) side, a coordinator's pending update ('Update B, TS_Commit=10') and its Txn Logic feed three transactions (Txn1-Txn3) whose pipelined RDMA operations are coordinated under two-phase locking ('2PL'); a Cache Management step (highlighted in red, matching CREST's other named techniques) shows the coordinator's Record Cache entry for key B, with a Ref, an EN Array, and a Version List, going through an admission step. On the MNs (memory-node) side, the corresponding Remote Records are laid out as a Header followed by a row of Cells, which the cache mode and admission logic on the compute side ultimately read from or write back to.
